exit 0
--- stdout
Record an operator ruling that defers an exact canonical command. Strict
admission then skips it and records it in the receipt with operator authority;
the deferred-validation batch satisfies it. A command a runtime input uses still
runs in the gate. --ruling must name the decision that authorizes the deferral.
Usage:
liza deferred-validation rule [flags]
Flags:
--command string exact canonical command
-h, --help help for rule
--json output result as structured JSON
--ruling string decision that authorizes this change
Global Flags:
--check-update check for a Liza update before running
-C, --project-root string Liza project root for state commands
--update-channel string update check channel: stable or main (default "stable")
-v, --verbose verbose output
--- stderr
